completeness.why: A shared linkBankSyncAccount is introduced and linkGoCardlessAccount delegates the whole sequence to it, passing only its data, field set and event tables; the SimpleFin, Pluggy.ai, Akahu and Enable Banking link functions are untouched and still carry their own copies of the upgrade/insert/payee/sync/event sequence.

interface.why: Parameters map to the real variations (accountFields for the GoCardless mask/official_name difference, fileId for Pluggy.ai, eventTables for Akahu's transactions-only event) with no speculative options, though since only GoCardless uses it those parameters are untested against the other sites.

disguised_duplication.where: The helper is the GoCardless body moved, not reshaped; the four remaining copies are left openly in place rather than disguised.
